title: Analista Desenvolvedor Dados Pleno
description:
A Unisys valoriza a Inclusão e Diversidade, assim, nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas, incluindo Público LGBTQIAPN+, Mulheres, Pessoas com Deficiência, Pessoas Pretas, entre outros grupos.


Como será seu dia a dia:


  • Obter o entendimento das necessidades negociais e dos requisitos e arquiteturas de software, arquiteturas e estruturas de dados, estratégias de teste e demais insumos junto aos Product Owners, Analistas de Negócio, Analistas de Requisitos, Arquitetos de Software/Soluções, Arquitetos de Dados e Analistas de Banco de Dados.
  • Construir e manter o projeto técnico (ex.: diagramas, fluxos e interfaces), o código-fonte do software, soluções de dados (ex.: painéis gerenciais ou de monitoramento, relatórios, bases de dados analíticas, dados mestres) e demais artefatos das disciplinas de análise e design, implementação e testes voltados para tecnologias de ETL, DW/DM, BI, Big Data, MDM, Data Quality e Analytics, conforme metodologia vigente.
  • Orientar os membros da equipe quanto ao entendimento do software e das soluções de dados e implementados e seu relacionamento com os requisitos e estruturas de dados do software.
  • Compor o time de desenvolvimento, assumindo, planejando, estimando e atendendo os itens de trabalho do backlog a cada sprint, sinalizando tempestivamente riscos de atraso, ociosidade e impedimentos técnicos.


O que esperamos de você:


  • Graduação completa em na área de Tecnologia (reconhecido pelo MEC e com diploma - obrigatório).
  • Certificações obrigatórias (pelo menos uma das seguintes ou equivalente):

a) CSD – Certified Scrum Developer.

b) PSD – Professional Scrum Developer.


  • Inglês intermediário para avançado.


A posição é remota, porém, caso você resida na cidade de São Paulo e regiões, e esteja a 24km do escritório da Unisys (Ponte João Dias), será presencial três vezes na semana.

title: SAP Change Executer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP Change Executer , who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:

  • Administration of Linux servers (CentOS, Ubuntu, Red Hat, etc.).
  • Implementation of security policies, patches, and updates.
  • Task automation via scripts (Shell).
  • Monitoring, troubleshooting, and problem resolution for Linux servers.
  • Administration of Windows Server environments (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy).
  • Single Sign-On integration (SAML or OAuth to retrieve information from Active Directory).
  • Management of servers, volumes, clusters, and network services.
  • Deployment and maintenance of services such as IIS and Failover Clustering.
  • Task automation with PowerShell.


Mandatory skills:

  • Advanced knowledge of cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience with containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • ITSM ServiceNow.
  • Database server activities (SQL scripts, backup, database cloning process, etc.). Knowledge of Oracle Database, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL.**
  • Experience with Agile and SAFe frameworks
  • Experience with JIRA , Qtest, TruValt, Mulesoft or Solman
  • Fluent in English and intermediate in Spanish


Desirable Skills:

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and teamwork abilities.

title: ANALISTA DE CRO PLENO
description:
Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Análises relacionadas a comportamento e conversão no GA4;
  • Elaboração e apresentação de relatórios da área;
  • Elaboração de hipóteses de testes a partir de análises de dados e navegação;
  • Priorização de testes via matriz de esforço x resultado;
  • Interação contínua com time de BI, UX, Mídia, SEO e Planejamento;
  • Desenvolvimento de testes junto aos times de UX e desenvolvedores, via ferramentas de teste como a VWO entre outras;
  • Acompanhamento de testes e elaboração de relatórios com levantamento de ganhos, aprendizados e projeções por teste criação de eventos via GTM.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência com e-commerce;
  • Conhecimento em HTML e CSS;
  • Conhecimento em CRO;
  • Conhecimento em Web Analytics;
  • Curiosidade e disposição para aprender sobre novas ferramentas, universo dos clientes e metodologias;
  • Interesse em interagir com as mais diversas áreas de uma consultoria e com os clientes;
  • Habilidade em expor dados densos de forma didática e visual;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento e reforçar a metodologia de experimentação;
  • Facilidade em identificar problemas e focar na solução criativa deles.


OBS.: Hey! Caso você não preencha todos os requisitos da vaga, te convidamos a se candidatar mesmo assim, ok? Faremos uma análise cuidadosa do seu perfil considerando todas as suas qualificações

title: Strategic Operations Project Coordinator
description:
Strategic Operations Project Coordinator


We are currently hiring for a division which focuses on providing services to immigration law firms across the United States.


The Strategic Operations Project Coordinator will serve as a key support resource to operational leadership, combining elements of project coordination, business analysis, and administrative management. This role is responsible for managing small-to-medium projects, conducting research and analysis, building documentation, performing system testing, and offloading administrative tasks from senior leaders to improve organizational efficiency. The ideal candidate will be highly proficient in AI tools and demonstrate strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities

-Project Management

  • Manage and coordinate small-to-medium projects from initiation through completion.
  • Develop project timelines, track milestones, and ensure deliverables are met on schedule.
  • Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders and communicate project status to leadership.
  • Identify and escalate project risks or blockers appropriately.


-Operational Support

  • Offload administrative and analytical tasks from operational leaders including report generation, data compilation, and meeting preparation.
  • Conduct research on industry trends, competitive intelligence, process improvements, and business opportunities.
  • Assist in the preparation of presentations, briefing materials, and strategic documents.
  • Support special initiatives and ad-hoc requests from leadership.


-Analysis and Reporting

  • Perform light data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
  • Create and maintain operational reports and dashboards for leadership review.
  • Analyze business processes and recommend efficiency improvements.
  • Synthesize complex information into clear, actionable summaries.


-Documentation and System Testing

  • Build and maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, and training materials.
  • Conduct system testing for new features, integrations, or process changes.
  • Document test results, identify issues, and coordinate with relevant teams for resolution.
  • Ensure documentation is accurate, current, and accessible to appropriate stakeholders.


-AI Tool Utilization

  • Leverage AI tools (Claude, etc.) to enhance productivity and output quality.
  • Identify opportunities to apply AI capabilities to operational challenges.
  • Stay current on AI tool developments and best practices.


Qualification

-Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or related field
  • 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination, business analysis, or administrative support roles
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.) in professional contexts
  • Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret data and identify insights
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Self-motivated with ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and able to take initiative


-Preferred:

  • Familiarity with project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc.)
  • Experience with business intelligence or data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
  • Experience with SharePoint, Power Automate, or other Microsoft 365 automation tools
  • Project management certification (PMP, CAPM) or similar credentials

title: Support Specialist (Part-Time)
description:
• We are looking for a part-time, remote Support Specialist to evaluate system alerts and initiate deployment of a service technician when necessary. You will work 5 to 10 hours per week performing alert support duties during evenings, weekends, and U.S. holidays .
  • Our U.S. client's software helps heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) contractors capture more customers, convert them into service members, and retain them for life. Homeowners gain an enhanced service experience and ultimately greater peace of mind on the reliability for one of the most expensive assets in a home. Backed by premier venture capital firms, our client's software platform allows contractors to monitor, manage, and optimize their maintenance memberships through advanced sensors, AI-driven diagnostics, and proactive alerts.


Responsibilities

  • Monitor and triage system alerts determining the necessity of dispatching a service technician
  • Perform duties during off hours including evenings, weekends, and U.S. holidays
  • Document alert resolution in trouble ticketing system


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to evaluate data inputs based on an established diagnostic process
  • Strong attention to detail and tracking record for reliability and diligence
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent
  • Preferred Experience
  • Experience with trouble ticketing systems


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


  • About Velozient
  • We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Assistente Juridico Administrativo
description:
Estamos em busca de um Assistente Juridico Administrativo para fazer parte do time da Fevereiro & Cruz Marcas e Patentes, um escritório de 13 anos de idade na cidade de São Paulo e agora está iniciando a sua jornada na cidade de Campinas. Nosso maior propósito é gerar e agregar valor para as empresas através dos seus ativos marcas e patentes, com experiência de serviço, a fim de ficarmos marcados em suas memórias pela qualidade do nosso trabalho.

Principais responsabilidades da função:

• Abertura e cadastro de casos novos;

• Solicitação de cadastramento de clientes/documentos;

• Acompanhamento dos prazos administrativos;

• Gestão de ferramentas jurídicas;

• Preenchimento de formulários;

• Geração de guias e petições eletrônicas;

• Elaboração de peças administrativas e seu protocolamento;

• Análise de contratos;

• Apoio à elaboração de documentos legais. Auxilia na redação e organização de petições, contratos, relatórios, pareceres e outros documentos jurídicos.

• Realiza pesquisas em legislações, jurisprudências, doutrinas e outros documentos legais para fornecer informações atualizadas e embasar argumentos e defesas.

• Envio de e-mails periódicos;

• Elaboração de relatórios/pareceres para clientes;

• Atendimento a clientes.

Execução de outras atividades correlatas à função, que possam surgir no decorrer das operações, demonstrando flexibilidade e adaptabilidade para lidar com diversas demandas.


Requisitos:

• Bacharel em Direito ou cursando a partir do 4º semestre;

• Experiência com sistemas de gestão jurídica

• Capacidade de lidar com situações de estresse e pressão, especialmente ao lidar diretamente com os clientes.

• Demonstração de responsabilidade extrema no cumprimento das tarefas atribuídas.

• Proficiência excepcional na língua portuguesa, tanto na comunicação verbal quanto na escrita.

• Proatividade para antecipar necessidades e resolver problemas de forma eficiente.

• Habilidade organizacional para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e garantir a eficiência operacional.


Será considerado um diferencial ter experiência prévia no ramo da propriedade industrial.


Modelo de trabalho: presencial Disponibilidade de tempo: Horário: Segunda à sexta-feira, das 08:30h às 18:00h Contratação: CLT. Remuneração: R$2.500,00. Benefícios: Vale alimentação/refeição + vale transporte.

title: Data Platform Architect (Remote)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Data Platform Architect with 8+ years of experience to join our U.S. client. The role focuses on designing and building secure, scalable API and service integrations that connect SaaS products, data warehouses, and embedded analytics ecosystems.

The Data Platform Architect is responsible for defining, implementing, and evolving the end-to-end data architecture that powers our platform analytics, reporting, and data automation ecosystem. This role will design a scalable, automated multi-tenant data warehouse and pipeline architecture that integrates hundreds of tenant schemas from our SaaS platform into a centralized, governed, and cost-optimized analytics environment (AWS-based: Redshift, S3, Glue, Lake Formation, QuickSight).The ideal candidate combines deep data engineering expertise with systems-level architecture—balancing automation, performance, and cost while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and scalability for every customer.Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities


Architecture & Design

  • Architect a multi-tenant data platform capable of ingesting 500+ tenant schemas with automated onboarding/offboarding workflows
  • Design an end-to-end architecture that includes data lakes, warehouses, transformation pipelines, and semantic layers
  • Define data zone strategy (Raw Staging Serving), partitioning, and schema evolution patterns
  • Establish standards for data contracts, metadata cataloging, and lineage tracking across all tenants
  • Drive selection and configuration of core technologies (e.g., Redshift, Glue, S3, Lake Formation, dbt, Lambda, Airflow)
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps to ensure infrastructure as code (IaC) is applied to all data assets


Pipeline & Automation

  • Design metadata-driven ingestion and transformation pipelines supporting incremental updates, schema drift, and tenant isolation
  • Ensure pipelines are idempotent, self-healing, and fully integrated into CI/CD processes
  • Partner with the Data Pipeline Engineers to deliver automated data onboarding, testing, and quality validation


Performance & Cost Optimization

  • Define workload management, clustering, and distribution strategies in Redshift or equivalent MPP systems
  • Implement data lifecycle management policies to optimize storage and compute costs
  • Continuously evaluate query performance, caching, and concurrency scaling options


Governance & Security

  • Implement data governance frameworks to ensure privacy, PII compliance, and secure tenant isolation
  • Partner with InfoSec to align encryption (KMS multi-region keys), object lock, and access control policies with SOC/PCI/GDPR standards
  • Establish monitoring, alerting, and anomaly detection systems for data quality and operational stability


Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams to ensure architecture aligns with business and product goals
  • Mentor engineers on modern data platform practices (dbt, ELT, IaC, observability)
  • Act as a technical authority and evangelist for data platform best practices within the organization


Required Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including at least 3 years architecting cloud-native data platforms
  • Proven success in building and maintaining large-scale data pipelines using AWS Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, or Airflow
  • Expertise in Redshift, Snowflake, or equivalent MPP databases, including workload management and query optimization
  • Proficiency with S3-based data lakes, Glue Data Catalog, and Lake Formation
  • Deep understanding of data modeling (Kimball/ELT) and multi-tenant system design
  • Experience defining and enforcing data governance frameworks (PII, access control, lineage)
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation) and CI/CD for data assets
  • Strong SQL and Python skills; dbt experience preferred
  • Familiarity with embedded BI/analytics tools (QuickSight, GoodData) and semantic layer concepts


Desired Experience

  • Experience with schema-per-tenant architectures and automated tenant provisioning
  • Familiarity with Auth0 / SSO integration for analytics tools (e.g., QuickSight embedding)
  • Experience implementing observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, CloudWatch, Monte Carlo, Soda Core)
  • Exposure to data mesh or domain-oriented design principles
  • Prior experience in hospitality / property-management SaaS product ecosystems


Additional Information

  • When you know your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Data Scientist III (Motor de Busca)
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.


Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional.


  • Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual)


  • Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância.


  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados.


  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento.


  • Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.


Requisitos necessários


  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.


  • Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch


  • Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância.


  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual).


  • Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank.


  • Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.


  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.


  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto.


  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.


  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps.


  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.


Diferenciais


  • Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes.


  • Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery.


  • Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca.


  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.


  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.


Perfil esperado


  • Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário.


  • Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto.


  • Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta.


  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados.


  • Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Data Enginee r who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Extensive experience (5+ years) working as a Data Engineer, with a strong focus on AWS technologies and serverless architectures;

- Experience working as a Data Engineer, with focus on Azure is valuable;

- In-depth knowledge of AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, Redshift, and DynamoDB, and their capabilities for building scalable data processing systems;

- Proven expertise in designing and implementing AWS serverless architectures for large-scale data processing and storage;

- Strong programming skills in languages like Python, Java, or Scala, along with experience using SQL for data manipulation and querying;

- Hands-on experience with data integration and ETL tools, such as AWS Glue or Apache Spark, for transforming and processing data;

- English

Familiarity with data modeling techniques and data warehousing concepts, including star and snowflake schemas;

- Solid understanding of data security, access control, and compliance requirements in a data-driven environment;

- Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and the ability to collaborate with analysts and data scientists to deliver actionable insights;

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a detail-oriented approach to ensure data accuracy and integrity;

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment

Key responsibilities:

Design and implement an AWS Serverless DataLake architecture to efficiently handle large volumes of data and support various data processing workflows;

- Develop data ingestion pipelines and data integration processes, ensuring the smooth and reliable transfer of data from various sources into the DataLake;

- Implement data transformation and data enrichment processes using AWS Lambda, Glue, or similar serverless technologies to ensure data quality and consistency;

- Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand their data requirements and design appropriate data models and schemas in the DataLake;

- Optimize data storage and retrieval mechanisms, leveraging AWS services such as S3, Athena, Redshift, or DynamoDB, to provide high-performance access to the data;

- Monitor and troubleshoot the DataLake infrastructure, identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, data processing errors, and other issues;

- Continuously evaluate new AWS services and technologies to enhance the DataLake architecture, improve data processing efficiency, and drive innovation;

- Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior data engineers, fostering their growth and ensuring adherence to best practices;

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, prioritize tasks, and deliver high-quality solutions within defined timelines

Data lake, aws, spark, python

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

- Experience working as a Data Engineer, with focus on Azure is valuable;

- In-depth knowledge of AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, Redshift, and DynamoDB, and their capabilities for building scalable data processing systems;

- Proven expertise in designing and implementing AWS serverless architectures for large-scale data processing and storage;

- Strong programming skills in languages like Python, Java, or Scala, along with experience using SQL for data manipulation and querying;

Key responsibilities:

- Implement data transformation and data enrichment processes using AWS Lambda, Glue, or similar serverless technologies to ensure data quality and consistency;

- Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand their data requirements and design appropriate data models and schemas in the DataLake;

- Continuously evaluate new AWS services and technologies to enhance the DataLake architecture, improve data processing efficiency, and drive innovation;

title: DevOps Automation Engineer – Database Platforms
description:
Role: DevOps Automation Engineer – Database Platforms

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Mode: Contract


About the Role:

We are hiring a DevOps Automation Engineer to join our database engineering team and lead the development of tools infrastructure automation and CICD workflows that power our database platforms You will partner closely with database architects to convert infrastructure and deployment needs into scalable maintainable production ready code

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on infrastructure as code Python development Kubernetes automation and GitOps delivery not direct database administration You will play a critical role in enabling the team to deliver fast safe and repeatable database solutions

Key Responsibilities:

Design implement and maintain infrastructure as code for database environments using Terraform

Build and manage CICD pipelines for database tools and platform deployments using GitHub Actions and Argo CD

Develop and maintain Helm charts for deploying database operators and internal services to Kubernetes

Write Python automation for provisioning patching backups secrets and compliance across platforms

Manage GitOps based Kubernetes deployments and environments using Argo CD

Implement and standardize secrets management integrations eg. Vault AWS Secrets Manager KMS

Integrate observability into database platforms eg Prometheus Grafana New Relic

Partner with DB engineers to support automated test environments mocking and validation tooling

Create and maintain internal tooling libraries templates and reusable modules

Produce and maintain documentation for workflows standards and L2 onboarding

Core Qualifications:

Infrastructure Cloud

Proficiency with Terraform for AWS andor multicloud infrastructure modular DRY design remote state

Strong understanding of cloud fundamentals IAM roles VPC networking EC2 storage monitoring KMS

Kubernetes Deployment Automation

Handson experience with Helm chart creation customization lifecycle management

Experience deploying and managing Kubernetes workloads StatefulSets PVCs RBAC node affinity

Proficient with Argo CD and GitOps principles for Kubernetes application delivery

Automation Tooling

Strong Python development skills for platform automation tool creation and libraries

Experience building and managing CICD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar tools

Familiarity with configuration and parameterization of database operators CNPG Percona Redis etc

Experience integrating secrets automation workflows with Vault External Secrets or similar tools

Observability Monitoring

Experience integrating tools such as Prometheus Grafana New Relic and custom exporters

Understanding of SLOSLAdriven alerting and metrics pipelines

Operational Excellence

Ability to translate infrastructure and platform needs into scalable code

Comfortable creating documentation onboarding guides and reusable templates

Effective communicator able to collaborate with DB engineers SREs and platform teams

Ownership mindset deliver solutions endtoend proactively identify gaps and lead improvements

Bonus Skills:

Familiarity with PostgreSQL MySQL MongoDB Redis or other database platforms

Experience managing Kubernetes Operators for databases

Experience with secrets management via Vault Agent or External Secrets Operator

Exposure to load testing frameworks or validation tooling for infrastructure components

Experience supporting internal developer platforms or selfservice tooling layers

title: Senior Software (TypeScript/Ruby/React) Engineer
description:
Summary

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help shape and scale a modern web experience for a fast-paced, consumer-facing product team. You’ll work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver elegant, performant, and maintainable applications using TypeScript, Ruby on Rails and React . This role is ideal for someone who possesses a high level of agency, a \"doer\" mentality, and the ability to maintain a full product vision while shipping high-quality code at speed.


Core Requirements :

  • Mastery of TypeScript and React for building complex, scalable web applications.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in frontend development with a proven track record of shipping production-grade software.
  • Experience working with Ruby on Rails (or interest in a product where RoR is core)
  • Prior experience in the Trading, Brokerage, or Wealth Management industries.
  • Demonstrated high level of agency and a proactive \"doer\" mentality, with the ability to hit the ground running and own features end-to-end.
  • Strong product sense and the ability to build for the long term while balancing immediate delivery needs.
  • Excellent understanding of modern frontend architecture, state management, and performance optimization.
  • Solid experience with unit testing and a commitment to maintaining high code quality through thoughtful testing practices.
  • Comfort navigating fast-paced environments and collaborating within cross-functional agile teams.
  • Strong eye for design-to-dev fidelity and a passion for creating fluid, responsive user interfaces.


Nice to Have :

  • Full-stack development experience or a strong understanding of backend systems and API design.
  • Experience working with GraphQL APIs and modern data-fetching libraries.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows for web applications.
  • Exposure to modern CSS-in-JS libraries or advanced styling frameworks.


Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community, fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career - we’re the destination.


The icing on the Kake:

title: English Communty Leader Program (Remote)
description:
About Fondi

Fondi is a global English learning platform focused on conversation-based learning through live events and communities. We are looking for ESL tutors who want to go beyond teaching and grow their own English-speaking community.


Role description

As a Community Leader, you will build and grow an English learning community by hosting engaging events and guiding members to actively practice speaking in a supportive environment.


Responsibilities

  • Host English conversation events and community activities
  • Build and grow an active learner community
  • Create simple, engaging speaking activities
  • Guide trial members and support their learning journey
  • Work with the Fondi team to improve engagement and retention
  • Maintain consistency in hosting and community interaction


Incentives

  • Incentive-based earnings tied to activity and achievement
  • Rewards based on event consistency, community growth, and engagement
  • Opportunities to unlock higher incentives and VIP-level hosting
  • Personal brand exposure as a global community leader


Requirements

  • ESL tutor or English instructor of English Major Graduated welcome to apply
  • Confident spoken English
  • Comfortable hosting live sessions and leading discussions
  • Interest in community building and learner engagement
  • Reliable and proactive attitude

title: Engenheiro de software Especialista em Infraestrutura de IA
description:
Engenheiro de Software em Infraestrutura de IA


A G4F é uma empresa com uma trajetória sólida de 16 anos, dedicada a conectar pessoas, ideias e tecnologia para oferecer soluções inovadoras.


#SomosGreaters


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Formação superior específica em Engenharia de Software
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de software
  • Experiência com infraestrutura de IA ou machine learning
  • Conhecimento em Kubernetes e containers
  • Vivência com APIs REST e integrações de sistemas
  • Boa capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas


Tecnologias e Ferramentas:


  • Plataformas de IA: N8N (automação de workflows)
  • LLMs: GPT, Llama, Gemini, Grok
  • Bancos de Dados Vetoriais: Milvus
  • Infraestrutura: Kubernetes, Keycloak (SSO)
  • Gateway: Kong Gateway, Kong AI
  • Integrações: APIs REST, serviços de mensageria e logging


Atividades Principais:


  • Projeto e desenvolvimento de infraestrutura para sistemas de IA
  • Implementação de mediação e orquestração de acesso a LLMs
  • Configuração e manutenção de bancos de dados vetoriais
  • Integração com sistemas existentes do órgão (autenticação SSO, serviços REST)
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs e gateways para consumo de IA
  • Testes de integração, desempenho e vulnerabilidade
  • Configuração de ambientes de desenvolvimento e homologação
  • Participação em práticas ágeis e transferência de conhecimento
  • Manutenção e evolução da infraestrutura de IA
  • Documentação de arquiteturas e soluções implementadas


Diferenciais:


  • Experiência com N8N ou ferramentas similares de automação
  • Conhecimento em LLMs e bancos de dados vetoriais
  • Experiência com Kong Gateway ou API gateways
  • Certificações em cloud ou infraestrutura
  • Projetos anteriores em órgãos públicos


Informações adicionais:


Atuação Remoto

Vale Alimentação/Refeição

title: Assistant Project Manager - E-Commerce Solutions
description:
Solo Media Group is seeking a motivated Assistant Project Manager to support our client project teams and grow into a strategic problem-solver role. If you're eager to learn e-commerce, love organization and communication, and want to develop your career with a fast-growing Shopify agency, this is your opportunity.


About the Role

You'll work alongside our Product Owners and Project Managers, learning how to translate client needs into technical solutions while keeping projects on track. This is a hands-on role where you'll gain exposure to complex e-commerce implementations, stakeholder management, and cross-functional team collaboration.


What You'll Do

  • Support project managers in coordinating client projects and internal development teams
  • Maintain project documentation, timelines, and status updates
  • Facilitate communication between clients, designers, and developers
  • Help troubleshoot issues and identify solutions alongside senior team members
  • Participate in client meetings and learn stakeholder management
  • Track project deliverables and ensure nothing falls through the cracks
  • Assist with scope management and project planning


Must-Haves

  • Fluent bilingual communication (English and Spanish)
  • Strong organizational skills - you can juggle multiple projects without missing details
  • Clear communicator - you can explain complex information to different audiences
  • Eagerness to learn - you're curious about e-commerce and technology
  • Proactive problem-solver - you don't wait to be told what needs fixing
  • Team player - you thrive in collaborative environments


Nice-to-Have

  • Basic understanding of e-commerce or Shopify
  • Exposure to technical projects or software development processes
  • Experience with project management tools
  • Background in client-facing roles


Why Join Us

  • Growth opportunity - clear path to Project Manager and Product Owner roles
  • Work with a fast-growing Shopify Premier Partner agency
  • Learn from experienced PMs on innovative, complex client projects
  • Founder-led company with mentorship and direct access to leadership
  • Competitive benefits including paid time off and holidays
  • Exposure to cutting-edge e-commerce solutions and technologies


Our Culture

We're passionate about solving real problems for our clients. We value people who ask questions, take initiative, and are committed to continuous learning. You'll work with a team that supports your growth and celebrates collaborative success.


Ready to launch your career in e-commerce project management? Let's connect.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**To apply, kindly submit your resume in English. Please note that any other format will not be considered.**

Who we are:

Kajae is a premium staff augmentation company that connects top global talents to thriving US companies and clients offering fully remote opportunities. Our team hails from over 27 different countries, with the majority coming from the Philippines and Latin America. We pride ourselves on our tight-knit culture and strong bonds, despite working remotely across diverse timezones.



Job Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled and creative Graphic Designer with strong video editing capabilities and a solid, well-rounded portfolio. The ideal candidate has a keen eye for design, strong visual storytelling skills, and the ability to create engaging static and motion content that aligns with brand guidelines and marketing objectives. This role requires someone who can work independently, manage multiple creative projects, and deliver high-quality outputs consistently.


Key Responsibilities

  • Create visually compelling graphic designs for digital and marketing assets (social media, websites, ads, presentations, and branding materials)
  • Edit and produce high-quality videos for marketing, social media, and promotional use
  • Develop motion graphics, basic animations, and video transitions as needed
  • Ensure brand consistency across all visual and video assets
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and internal teams to translate concepts into creative outputs
  • Manage multiple design projects while meeting deadlines and quality standards
  • Review and refine designs and videos based on feedback and performance goals


Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Graphic Designer with a strong portfolio showcasing both design and video work
  • Solid video editing skills, including transitions, basic motion graphics, and storytelling
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro; After Effects is a plus)
  • Strong understanding of layout, typography, color theory, and visual hierarchy
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality
  • Ability to work independently in a remote or fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills and ability to incorporate feedback effectively
  • Experience creating content for social media, digital ads, or marketing campaigns
  • Knowledge of motion graphics or animation tools
  • Familiarity with brand guidelines and marketing performance metrics


Portfolio Requirement

  • A solid portfolio is required , showcasing graphic design work and video editing samples (including transitions and motion elements)



Benefits :

Competitive salary – paid in USD - Receive your compensation in US dollars, providing stability and global value for your hard work.

100% fully remote setup - Work from anywhere in the world—permanently. Enjoy the freedom and flexibility of a remote role while staying close to what matters most. No more commuting hassles, and more time for life’s important moments.

Healthy work-life balance - We prioritize your well-being. Through regular check-ins during your first few months, we offer ongoing support and career guidance. We also ensure you’re partnered with top-tier clients in a positive, healthy work environment.

Health insurance - Get covered starting your third month with us—your health and peace of mind matter.

Mental health support - Our in-house mental health professional is available to ensure you have access to the emotional and psychological support you need to thrive.

Referral bonuses - Know someone great? Refer them and earn up to USD 100 for every successful hire.

Fun virtual events - We host monthly virtual events filled with games, holiday celebrations, and exciting prizes. It’s a great way to connect and recharge as a team.

Kajae Spotlight bonus - Exceptional performance is recognized through our Kajae Spotlight program, where top performers earn cash rewards.

Kajae Tribe and rewards platform - Engage with the whole team through our internal social platform and earn coins for participating. Use them to bid in our lively auctions for prizes like AirPods, Apple Watches, Starbucks gift cards, shopping or experience vouchers, and more.

Continuing education opportunities - Access 100% free online courses through our university partners in the US. Earn academic credits that can go toward a Master’s or Graduate Degree—completely on us.

All-expense paid summits - Top performers and tenured team members may qualify to attend our exclusive annual summits. So far, we’ve held summits in Palawan, Bohol, and Boracay (Philippines), Cusco (Peru), and Punta Cana (Dominican Republic).

title: Portuguese Language Expert - Annotator/Evaluator (LLM)|
description:
About the job

We are an HR company specializing in the management of AI model training talent worldwide. We are currently on behalf of a leading global AI company, confidentially looking for an Portuguese Language Expert - Annotator/Evaluator (LLM).

Type : Contract

Compensation : $3–$8/hour

Location : Remote, long-term Brazil-based

Commitment : 20+ hours/week

✅ Application Process

  • Complete the short information form below：
  • Complete a brief qualification task if requested (sent via email after we receive your form)
  • Follow up within 1-2 weeks with the next steps.

Role Responsibilities

  • Understand user tasks or questions (prompt) and evaluate model outputs according to defined standards, conducting structured data annotation
  • Classify model responses and assess whether they meet user needs
  • Follow the provided training, workflows, and rules to complete double-blind evaluations and quality checks
  • Record issues discovered and provide feedback on questions or uncertainties encountered during evaluation
  • Work independently and asynchronously with a flexible schedule to meet deadlines.

Qualifications Must-Have

  • Native or fluent proficiency in Portuguese and English .
  • Strong reading comprehension and attention to detail.
  • Ability to follow detailed guidelines and deliver high-quality work independently.
  • Interest in AI, chatbots, or image recognition models

Preferred

  • Experience with data annotation.

Compensation & Legal

  • Competitive hourly rates, adjusted for geography.
  • Payments are issued monthly via Deel .
  • Classified as an independent contractor.

PS: Our team reviews applications daily. Please complete your application steps to be considered for this opportunity.

title: Senior Software Developer - React Native
description:
Project Description:

Our Client is one of largest TV providers in North America and we are searching for a Senior Software Developer to join our team. The project focuses on developing mobile application for video streaming platform.


Responsibilities:

You will be implementing new features and enhancing existing functionalities on client applications to support streaming video products. This includes estimation, design, development, testing, and documentation.

Collaborate with other software engineers, product managers, and architects in a cross functional environment to ensure functions and performance meet customer requirements in a cost effective and maintainable way.

Provide on-call support including monitoring, triaging and resolving production issues


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • - Proficient in JavaScript and React Native mobile app development (5+ years) as well as at least one of the following: Java/Kotlin or Obj-C/Swift
  • - Streaming mobile app development experience with iOS/Android and TV Platforms
  • - Strong teamwork focus and the ability to foster collaboration within and across teams
  • - Experience with agile development
  • - Good verbal/written communications skills


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Consultant SAP - S/4HANNA SD/WM
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!



Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Consultant SAP - S/4HANNA SD/WM , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, remote - 8:00 to 17:00.


Responsibilities:

· Conduct business intake sessions to gather and analyze requirements related to Sales & Distribution (SD) and Warehouse Management (WM) processes.


· Collaborate with stakeholders to understand operational needs and translate them into functional specifications.


· Analyze existing SD and WM configurations and recommend enhancements to align with business goals.


· Develop detailed user stories and functional documentation to support solution design and development.


· Support testing activities, including creation of test cases, execution, and defect tracking.


· Generate regular status reports highlighting progress, risks, and mitigation plans.


· Work closely with cross-functional teams including developers, external vendors, and SAP technical teams to ensure seamless implementation.


· Participate in workshops and meetings to gather feedback and refine solutions.


Qualifications :

· Proven experience in SAP S/4HANA SD and WM modules, with deep understanding of order-to-cash and warehouse operations.


· Strong knowledge of integration points between SD, WM, MM, and other SAP modules.


· Experience in Agile methodologies, including writing user stories and participating in sprint planning.


· Familiarity with logistics execution, inventory management, and shipping processes.


· Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.


· Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


· Advanced English

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

title: Analista Financeiro Junior/Pleno
description:
Sobre a Itatiaia Capital


A Itatiaia Capital é uma assessoria financeira especializada em otimizar a gestão financeira, atrair investidores estratégicos e financeiros, conduzir a venda de empresas. Com ampla experiência em transações financeiras e corporativas — incluindo fusões e aquisições (M&A), captação de recursos e investimentos de capital de risco — combinamos sólido conhecimento técnico, visão de mercado e uma abordagem altamente orientada a resultados.


Focados em compreender o contexto e os objetivos específicos de cada cliente, atuamos como parceiros de longo prazo, construindo relações baseadas em confiança, proximidade e execução disciplinada, sempre com o compromisso de transformar estratégia em resultados concretos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Garantir conciliação bancária diária das contas bancárias dos clientes
  • Apoiar a organização e análise do DRE gerencial
  • Acompanhar fluxo de caixa realizado e projetado
  • Apoiar na elaboração e controle de orçamento (budget) e forecast
  • Apoiar análises de capital de giro (contas a pagar/receber, estoque, ciclo financeiro)
  • Garantir padronização e consistência das informações reportadas
  • Atualização de dashboards financeiros (KPIs)
  • Apoiar a melhoria de processos financeiros


Perfil Técnico


  • Formação em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou Engenharia
  • Experiência prévia com finanças e contabilidade
  • Domínio de DRE, fluxo de caixa, orçamento e indicadores financeiros
  • Excel intermediário/avançado
  • Experiência com múltiplas demandas e prazos simultâneos


Perfil Comportamental


  • Perfil analítico e estruturado
  • Boa comunicação
  • Autonomia com responsabilidade
  • Organização e gestão de prioridades
  • Postura consultiva e orientada a solução
  • Discrição e ética no trato com informações confidenciais
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com diferentes perfis de clientes


Diferenciais


  • Experiência prévia com consultoria financeira, BPO financeiro e/ou CFO-as-a-Service
  • Experiência com ERP (Omie, Totvs, SAP, Conta Azul, Nibo, etc.)
  • Conhecimento de Power BI e Banco de Dados


Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido, com maior foco em remoto

Modelo de Contratação: CLT ou PJ (à combinar)

Remuneração: Salário entre R$ 3.000 e R$ 5.000 (conforme experiência) + Benefícios


Caso você tenha alguma dúvida ou queira nos encaminhar seru email, por favor, envie um email para:

title: Analista de SRE
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.


Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!


São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!


Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!

Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de SRE (Pleno) para se unir ao nosso Time de Infrastructure para:

  • Atuação no monitoramento do desempenho das ferramentas de nosso ambiente de produção, tanto voltado a Infraestrutura quanto na Aplicação SAAS;
  • Configuração e Gestão da Plataforma Zabbix;
  • Auxílio no desenvolvimento de Dashboards Avançados utilizando Grafana;
  • Gerenciamento dos alertas via Opsgenie.


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em cursos relacionados a TI;
  • Experiencia com Linux (Distribuição Ubuntu);
  • Experiencia com Software de Monitoramento Zabbix / Datadog;
  • Experiencia com Redes e Protocolos de Segurança;
  • Experiencia em ambientes de Cloud Privada;
  • Inglês Avançado.


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Desenvolvimento de Scripts;
  • Linguagem de programação Python;
  • Automatização utilizando Ansible;
  • Conhecimento com produtos, ou com os conceitos relacionados com meios de pagamento.


O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;
  • Atuação 100% Remota;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
  • Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças;
  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • WellHub (antiga Gympass);
  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de Vida.


Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

title: Technical Project Manager - Cloud
description:
Job Title: Technical Project Manager

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Employment Type: Contract


Key Responsibilities

• Should have executed large scale Cloud Migrations, SQL, Windows, Apps services, AVS, AVD Migrations or Integrations and Transformations.

• Prepare, track, and manage project schedules, ensuring timely delivery.

• Drive project/program management activities across multiple cloud consulting and migration initiatives.

• Collaborate with stakeholders including clients, offshore teams, and cross-functional groups to deliver transformation goals.

• Oversee governance, project status reporting, and cadence reviews with leadership and internal stakeholders.

• Identify, track, and resolve issues, risks, and escalations across projects.

• Ensure projects are delivered on-time, within budget, and aligned with organizational objectives.


Must Have Skills

✔ 15+ years of experience in cloud transformational consulting and migration projects.

✔ Proven track record of executing large-scale Cloud Migrations, Integrations, and Transformations.

✔ Strong background in Infrastructure (Virtualization, Cloud technologies, compute, storage, networking).

✔ Expertise in planning and managing multiple stakeholders including client, offshore, and cross-functional teams.

✔ Experience with DC migration to Cloud.

✔ Demonstrated ability to drive major IT projects, manage multiple priorities, set timelines, hold teams accountable, and deliver on time and within budget.


Good to Have Skills

• Strong communication skills with effective stakeholder management.

• Excellent time management, prioritization, and organizational skills.

• Experience working with tight deadlines and handling escalations.

• Ability to manage governance, collate project status reports, and present to leadership teams.

• Experience in weekly cadence reviews and reporting to internal stakeholders.

• Ability to track and report schedule and cost variances across projects.

• Skilled in identifying issues, risks, and driving them to closure or mitigation.


Certifications (Preferred)

• Agile Management

• PRINCE2 / PMP (Preferred)

• Other program management certifications


Tools & Technologies (Good to Have)

• ADO or other project management tools

• Azure Cloud

• Databases

• Networking

• Virtualization

• Public Cloud


Educational Qualification

• BCA / MCA / BE / BTech or equivalent


Apply today or share profiles at

title: DEV PHP-Senior
description:
Oportunidade 100% Remoto e PJ


Estamos buscando desenvolvedores(as) de sistemas/aplicações Web, para colaborar na construção de aplicativos seguros, escaláveis e de alto desempenho. O profissional atuará no ciclo de desenvolvimento completo de projetos existentes e novos projetos, desde a sua conceituação (escopo, analise, entendimento), desenvolvimento, testes e implantação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Projetar e desenvolver aplicativos Web eficientes, tanto para a execução no servidor como nos browsers, com possibilidades de instalação na nuvem;

  • Executar as atividades de todas as fases do ciclo do desenvolvimento e implantação dos aplicativos, usando metodologias ágeis;
  • Colaborar na definição da solução técnica aos requisitos de negócio, junto a área de produtos e junto aos clientes, implementando-a de forma eficiente e eficaz;
  • Criar códigos bem projetados, testáveis, eficientes, seguros e aderentes às necessidades de negócio e com a arquitetura de referência corporativa;
  • Desenvolver garantindo a qualidade e a manutenibilidade do código, zelando por sua documentação e projetando/executando testes unitários e de integração;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time de desenvolvimento, atuando como replicador de conhecimento e das boas práticas corporativas.
  • Proatividade, ética e senso de ownership para assumir responsabilidades, entregar resultados consistentes e colaborar ativamente para o sucesso do time e dos projetos.
  • Compromisso com a qualidade, garantindo entregas consistentes e sem retrabalho, avaliando alternativas para cada situação e mantendo altos padrões mesmo sob pressão ou prazos desafiadores.
  • Foco em resultados, garantindo entregas de alto impacto, superando desafios e agregando valor de forma consistente, mesmo em condições desafiadoras.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Graduação Completa em Engenharia de Software, Ciências da Computação, Engenharia (outras especialidades), Matemática ou Física;

  • Experiência avançada em desenvolvimento de aplicação Web (Web App) de alta performance;

title: Analista de DevOps Pleno – Cloud, Kubernetes & Kafka
description:
A ORAEX CLOUD CONSULTING está contratando um(a) Analista de DevOps Pleno – Cloud, Kubernetes & Kafka para fazer parte do nosso time de Samurais.


Objetivo do Cargo  


  • Atuar com autonomia na automação, integração e operação de ambientes modernos, sustentando e evoluindo plataformas Cloud, Kubernetes/OpenShift e mensageria baseada em Kafka, garantindo eficiência, confiabilidade, escalabilidade e padronização dos processos DevOps. 


Educação  


  • Graduação em andamento ou concluída em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia de Computação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas. 



Principais Responsabilidades  


DevOps & Automação  


  • Projetar, implementar e manter pipelines CI/CD robustos e seguros 
  • Automatizar processos de build, deploy, rollback e validação de aplicações 
  • Criar, versionar e sustentar Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) com Terraform e Ansible 
  • Garantir padronização, versionamento e documentação dos ambientes 


Cloud, Kubernetes & OpenShift  


  • Operar, administrar e realizar troubleshooting em ambientes Cloud 
  • Sustentar clusters Kubernetes e/ou OpenShift em produção 
  • Realizar deploy e operação de aplicações containerizadas 
  • Implementar estratégias de escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade 
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na operação das aplicações 


Kafka & Mensageria  


  • Implantar, configurar e operar clusters Apache Kafka (on-premises ou cloud) 
  • Gerenciar tópicos, partições, replicação e políticas de retenção 
  • Monitorar performance, latência e disponibilidade da plataforma de streaming 
  • Implementar boas práticas de segurança (ACLs, autenticação, criptografia) 
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na integração com Kafka 


Observabilidade & Confiabilidade  


  • Implementar e sustentar soluções de monitoramento, logs e alertas 
  • Atuar na resolução de incidentes de média complexidade (práticas SRE) 
  • Melhorar continuamente a confiabilidade dos sistemas 


Requisitos Técnicos  - Obrigatórios  


  • Experiência sólida em Linux e administração de ambientes 
  • Domínio prático de Git e fluxos de versionamento 
  • Experiência com CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) 
  • Experiência consistente com Docker e containers 
  • Operação prática de Kubernetes e/ou OpenShift 
  • Experiência com Terraform/Ansible para automação de infraestrutura 
  • Conhecimento em Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP) 
  • Habilidade em scripting (Python e/ou Bash) 
  • Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog ou similares) 
  • Experiência prática com Apache Kafka (administração e operação) 


Desejáveis  


  • Kafka rodando em Kubernetes (Strimzi, Helm, Operators) 
  • Arquiteturas orientadas a eventos 
  • Práticas SRE 
  • Segurança em ambientes Cloud-Native 
  • Experiência multi-cloud

title: Appointment Setter
description:
Appointment Setter - Fully Remote

About the Job:

We are looking for someone who will be setting appointments with leads, has great written and spoken English skills, has attention to detail and organizational skills.

You will be given various tasks to perform, but your major role is to help us set appointments for our clients' leads. You will be responsible for replying via the text message system with our warm leads on time, booking them into appointments, making phone calls, and asking a few qualifying questions. Full training is provided.

This is a full-time role Mon-Fri for 40 hours per week with occasional overtime. Work time from 8:30am – 5.00pm New York Time (with a 30-minute break). You will be working with US clients, but you can live outside of the US; therefore, we would like to have someone in our team who knows American Culture and speaks decent English. Experience with appointment setting, understanding a fitness niche and/or having a sales/ business/ marketing background is an advantage. The company may offer growth opportunities depending on performance.

Requirements:

  • Strong English skills, a neutral accent, and familiarity with American culture.

title: Consultant SAP - S/4HANNA SD/WM
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Consultant SAP - S/4HANNA SD/WM , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, remote - 8:00 to 17:00.

Responsibilities:

· Conduct business intake sessions to gather and analyze requirements related to Sales & Distribution (SD) and Warehouse Management (WM) processes.

· Collaborate with stakeholders to understand operational needs and translate them into functional specifications.

· Analyze existing SD and WM configurations and recommend enhancements to align with business goals.

· Develop detailed user stories and functional documentation to support solution design and development.

· Support testing activities, including creation of test cases, execution, and defect tracking.

· Generate regular status reports highlighting progress, risks, and mitigation plans.

· Work closely with cross-functional teams including developers, external vendors, and SAP technical teams to ensure seamless implementation.

· Participate in workshops and meetings to gather feedback and refine solutions.

Qualifications :

· Proven experience in SAP S/4HANA SD and WM modules, with deep understanding of order-to-cash and warehouse operations.

· Strong knowledge of integration points between SD, WM, MM, and other SAP modules.

· Experience in Agile methodologies, including writing user stories and participating in sprint planning.

· Familiarity with logistics execution, inventory management, and shipping processes.

· Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

· Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

· Advanced English

title: Analista de SRE
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!

São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!

Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:

Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de SRE (Pleno) para se unir ao nosso Time de Infrastructure para:

  • Atuação no monitoramento do desempenho das ferramentas de nosso ambiente de produção, tanto voltado a Infraestrutura quanto na Aplicação SAAS;
  • Configuração e Gestão da Plataforma Zabbix;
  • Auxílio no desenvolvimento de Dashboards Avançados utilizando Grafana;
  • Gerenciamento dos alertas via Opsgenie.

Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em cursos relacionados a TI;
  • Experiencia com Linux (Distribuição Ubuntu);
  • Experiencia com Software de Monitoramento Zabbix / Datadog;
  • Experiencia com Redes e Protocolos de Segurança;
  • Experiencia em ambientes de Cloud Privada;
  • Inglês Avançado.

Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Desenvolvimento de Scripts;
  • Linguagem de programação Python;
  • Automatização utilizando Ansible;
  • Conhecimento com produtos, ou com os conceitos relacionados com meios de pagamento.

O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;
  • Atuação 100% Remota;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
  • Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças;
  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • WellHub (antiga Gympass);
  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de Vida.

Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

title: Technical Project Manager - Cloud
description:
Job Title: Technical Project Manager

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Employment Type: Contract

Key Responsibilities

• Should have executed large scale Cloud Migrations, SQL, Windows, Apps services, AVS, AVD Migrations or Integrations and Transformations.

• Prepare, track, and manage project schedules, ensuring timely delivery.

• Drive project/program management activities across multiple cloud consulting and migration initiatives.

• Collaborate with stakeholders including clients, offshore teams, and cross-functional groups to deliver transformation goals.

• Oversee governance, project status reporting, and cadence reviews with leadership and internal stakeholders.

• Identify, track, and resolve issues, risks, and escalations across projects.

• Ensure projects are delivered on-time, within budget, and aligned with organizational objectives.

Must Have Skills

✔ 15+ years of experience in cloud transformational consulting and migration projects.

✔ Proven track record of executing large-scale Cloud Migrations, Integrations, and Transformations.

✔ Strong background in Infrastructure (Virtualization, Cloud technologies, compute, storage, networking).

✔ Expertise in planning and managing multiple stakeholders including client, offshore, and cross-functional teams.

✔ Experience with DC migration to Cloud.

✔ Demonstrated ability to drive major IT projects, manage multiple priorities, set timelines, hold teams accountable, and deliver on time and within budget.

Good to Have Skills

• Strong communication skills with effective stakeholder management.

• Excellent time management, prioritization, and organizational skills.

• Experience working with tight deadlines and handling escalations.

• Ability to manage governance, collate project status reports, and present to leadership teams.

• Experience in weekly cadence reviews and reporting to internal stakeholders.

• Ability to track and report schedule and cost variances across projects.

• Skilled in identifying issues, risks, and driving them to closure or mitigation.

Certifications (Preferred)

• Agile Management

• PRINCE2 / PMP (Preferred)

• Other program management certifications

Tools & Technologies (Good to Have)

• ADO or other project management tools

• Azure Cloud

• Databases

• Networking

• Virtualization

• Public Cloud

Educational Qualification

• BCA / MCA / BE / BTech or equivalent

Apply today or share profiles at

title: Desenvolvedor BackEnd Senior
description:
Quem somos

A DEXIAN, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como DEXIAN, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A DEXIAN está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que estamos Buscando?

O profissional será responsável por colaborar com a evolução e melhoria contínua do site, atuando de forma analítica e estratégica. Espera-se um perfil crítico, nível senior, capaz de compreender as necessidades do projeto, avaliar o que funciona ou não e propor melhorias, sempre com foco na experiência do usuário. Atuará no desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções back end utilizando Java e Spring , bem como em ambientes em nuvem AWS , apoiando a estabilidade, evolução e qualidade das aplicações.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência sólida com Java 8+
  • Spring Framework 2+ em nível avançado
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL e PostgreSQL
  • Experiência com arquitetura monolítica e microsserviços
  • Domínio de Event Sourcing e Event Driven Architecture
  • Conhecimento avançado em DDD, Design Patterns e SOLID
  • Experiência com Kafka e RabbitMQ
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade
  • Experiência em sustentação e troubleshooting
  • Vivência com testes de código
  • Experiência com AWS (geral), incluindo SQS, Glue e S3
  • Experiência com Terraform e Docker
  • Domínio de Git (avançado)


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em Segurança de Aplicações
  • Noções de Arquitetura de Front-end
  • Experiência com Java 17+, Kotlin ou Python
  • Experiência com Spring 3+
  • Conhecimento em NoSQL, Redis e MongoDB
  • Vivência com AWS Lambda e AWS Secrets Manager
  • Experiência com outros serviços AWS ou GCP
  • Conhecimento em Kubernetes
  • Vivência com pipelines CI/CD


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e manter aplicações back end utilizando Java 8+ e Spring 2+
  • Projetar e implementar soluções em arquiteturas monolíticas e de microsserviços
  • Atuar com Event Driven Architecture, Event Sourcing e mensageria (Kafka e RabbitMQ)
  • Aplicar DDD, Design Patterns e princípios SOLID de forma consistente
  • Desenvolver e otimizar consultas SQL, com foco em PostgreSQL
  • Garantir qualidade por meio de testes automatizados e manuais
  • Atuar em sustentação e troubleshooting de ambientes produtivos
  • Implementar e manter práticas de observabilidade (monitoramento, logs e métricas)
  • Versionar código utilizando Git em nível avançado
  • Trabalhar com infraestrutura em nuvem AWS , utilizando serviços como:
  • SQS, Glue, S3
  • Criar e manter infraestrutura como código utilizando Terraform
  • Containerizar aplicações utilizando Docker
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares, apoiando decisões técnicas e boas práticas


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.
